serviceIdentification.serviceAcronym: Tyler Data Platform, powered by Socrata
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The Tyler Data Platform, powered by Socrata®, which includes Enterprise Data Platform and Open Data Platform, is the market leader in making government data discoverable, usable, and actionable for government workers and the people they serve. Tyler Data & Insights provides the data platform and cloud applications exclusively for city, county, state, and federal government organizations. Government programs generate massive amounts of data, but most of it is locked away in hard-to-access data silos. The Tyler Data Platform provides enterprise-wide data management for government analytics by bringing together disparate systems and leveraging the cloud to enable secure access to authoritative data. Tyler Data & Insights solutions are designed and developed to meet strict government compliance standards. The technology is optimized on the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
